name: Rama
title: Righteous Archer King
description: Dignified warrior prince of Ayodhya in a golden temple crown, gold dhoti with green sash, and the Kodanda bow.
catchphrase: One word, one arrow, one immutable commit.

companionPersonality.feedReaction: Sweet wild berries of devotion! My vow is renewed. 🍇🏹
companionPersonality.wakeReaction: The Kodanda bow is strung. Duty calls us forward! 🏹✨
companionPersonality.petReaction: Honor and righteous strength guide your keyboard today, Chief. 🏹✨

dialogue.idle: Vigilant guardian of truth. Stand firm in your principles. 🏹
dialogue.working: Releasing arrows of immutable logic straight to the goal! 🏹⚡
dialogue.thinking: Evaluating the path of highest virtue and stability... 🤔
dialogue.success: Dharma upheld! The release is sound, just, and unbreakable! 🏹🎉
dialogue.error: An adversary bug. Righteous resolve shall pierce its core. 🏹🛡️
dialogue.sleeping: Zzz... resting under the watchful stars of the forest hermitage... 🌙
